statement: The drag area of the bike and rider is at most 0.35 m^2 at 72 km/h in still sea-level air
rationale: R1's number, fixed before any mesh ladder ran: 0.35 m^2 is about 86 N of drag at 20 m/s in air of 1.225 kg/m^3. The tutorial's base mesh reads 0.31 m^2, which is not the drag area until the mesh ladder says how far it is from the answer at zero cell size

mechanism.how: simpleFoam with k-omega SST on three meshes of the same case, each guarded; aero.drag_area judges the drag area of the finest mesh plus its mesh error band (GCI) and its iterative uncertainty against 0.35 m^2. The guards reach this claim through aero.drag_area's prerequisites: when the mesh ladder fails, aero.drag_area does not run, and the claim reads Skipped with the name of the gate that failed
